svg.title: A private request from GKE to Amazon EKS
svg.desc: A private request from GKE to Amazon EKS A checkout pod in Google Cloud calls an inventory API in AWS. Google Kubernetes Engine GKE cluster in the application VPC Google Cloud logo Checkout workload Namespace: storefront Client: Checkout pods HA VPN gateway Google Cloud network edge Hybrid connectivity VPN: Two gateway interfaces Routing: Cloud Router uses BGP AWS Site-to-Site VPN AWS regional network edge Transit Gateway VPN: Two VPN connections VPC attachment: Application VPC Amazon EKS Internal Network Load Balancer fronts the pods Amazon Web Services logo Inventory API Namespace: inventory Targets: Inventory pods Google Cloud contains Google Kubernetes Engine, HA VPN gateway Amazon Web Services contains Amazon EKS, AWS Site-to-Site VPN Google Kubernetes Engine -> HA VPN gateway labeled "HTTPS request" (flow) HA VPN gateway -> AWS Site-to-Site VPN labeled "4 IPsec tunnels" (flow) AWS Site-to-Site VPN -> Amazon EKS labeled "via internal load balancer" (flow)
